provenance.note: Every value in this file is read from the CI run at verified_source_sha. None of it was produced locally. Local verification is structurally unavailable here: local.env pins SUPABASE_URL to http://127.0.0.1:1 under production containment, and ci:assert-staging fails closed rather than resolving a staging target off-CI. The authoritative receipts are therefore the CI ones named below, and they are cited with run and job ids so a reviewer can open them.

verify_result.detail: The required `verify` check completed successfully at the exact anchor SHA. This supersedes the earlier PENDING-CI sentinel, which was accurate when written and is no longer.

receipt.consumed_by: scripts/ci/verify-db-proof-receipt.ts inside the required verify job
receipt.producer_gate: verify's 'Assert the DB proof producer succeeded' step read `staging-db-proof result: success`; it fails closed on any other result

test_db_result.target_note: The receipt's target is masked in the CI log by secret redaction. It is the staging project, not production — staging-path-enforcement and the workflow-production-credential-guard both gate this job, and production credentials are not available to it.

t1_live_proof_suites.step: Run the T1 live proof suites against staging
t1_live_proof_suites.detail: Every live proof suite in the step reported `# fail 0`. These run against the staging database, not in-memory repositories.

route_auth_change.before: reachable by any anonymous caller who knew or guessed a pick UUID; returned the full lifecycle aggregate
route_auth_change.after: requires an authenticated credential with role `operator`
route_auth_change.role_source: stated inline at apps/api/src/server.ts because ROUTE_ROLES lives in apps/api/src/auth.ts, a Tier C path this lane is not authorized to edit; authorizeRoute denies by default when no pattern matches, so routing the trace path through it would answer every authenticated operator with 403
route_auth_change.role_parity: `operator` is the same role the kill-switch GET requires, which is the closest existing precedent for staff-only operational state
route_auth_change.follow_up: the policy belongs in ROUTE_ROLES and should move there when a lane is authorized to touch auth.ts
